entities.summary: Paul Anthelme Bourde was a French journalist, author and colonial administrator. Self-taught, he became a respected contributor to Le Temps, writing on a broad range of subjects. He was hostile to the poets associated with the Decadent movement and positive about colonial enterprises. He did much to improve agriculture, particularly the cultivation of olives, in Tunisia. Paul Bourde was a poets & playwrights from Voissant (1851-05-22, Voissant–1914-10-27). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
